qa_pairs.question: What will the fuel consumption display show when the car is stopped but the engine is running?
qa_pairs.answer: EC will always display infinite fuel consumption when idling (car stopped - engine running).

qa_pairs.question: What should the fuel consumption display show during coasting with no fuel injection?
qa_pairs.answer: The display will be close to zero in the coasting phase with coasting shutoff, i.e. no fuel injection.

qa_pairs.question: What could cause an unrealistic display showing only 6 liters in 4th gear at full load?
qa_pairs.answer: This could be caused by a wrong or broken coding plug.

qa_pairs.question: How do you fix a coding plug issue with the fuel consumption display?
What are the possible causes when the EC display shows excessive fuel consumption?
qa_pairs.answer: Wrong temperature on quartz or coding plug wrong.

qa_pairs.question: What correction is needed if the fuel consumption display shows no reading at all?
qa_pairs.answer: Check injection signal on instrument cluster plug (blue) pin 2, check plug connection, or replace tachometer with economy control.

qa_pairs.question: What causes the display needle to wander when the car is idling?
How do you fix display needle wandering in idle condition?
qa_pairs.answer: Disconnect black wire of term. 1 on instrument cluster plug, pull out wire in wire harness and wrap it around the wire harness.

qa_pairs.question: What causes the display needle to wander when switching on lights or operating the headlight flasher?
What part number relay should be used to fix dimmer relay disturbance?
qa_pairs.answer: Replace low beam (dimmer) relay. Only install a diode relay, Part No. 61 31 1 373 154.
